_doc: The caoshu exemplars: one source scan (download it unmodified from source.url into --source-dir and check its SHA-1), per target the crop box in source pixels (x0, y0, x1, y1) and cs_exemplar.py's parameters (box_mm: the frame on the sheet, 150 mm singles / the work's frame; exclude: source rectangles of a neighbour's ink; weak_scale: hysteresis for faint ligatures; hair_r: keep hairlines; split_src_y: the source rows between a work's characters). line = the scroll line the characters come from. Version 2 (10-09, ink_v 2): whole ink components (never clipped at the box; `cut` severs a ligature into a neighbour), `bridge_lines` joins a 牽絲 the scan shows as dashes along its path, `close_regions` fills the 飛白 of one stroke, edges smoothed on the signed distance with hairlines exempt; spur_k_fan below its default keeps a short stroke end that meets a junction beside a longer branch (中's vertical above its loop, 臨's top), which the skeleton pruning would otherwise drop. cs_qa.py draws each target's outline on the scan for review.

source.title: 張旭《古詩四帖》 (attributed to Zhang Xu, Tang, 8th century; ink on coloured paper; Liaoning Provincial Museum)
